artifact_scope: Local single-RTX-3080 execution gates for external systems. Only systems that pass strict two-model streaming and lifecycle post-conditions receive performance results.

llama_swap.mechanism: OpenAI proxy that terminates and starts one vLLM process per selected model

serverless_llm.gate_observation: Qwen2.5-1.5B inference succeeded; DELETE /v1/models/qwen-1.5b removed the model from /v1/models, while the structured local gate summary reported total GPU use of 6171 MiB for the full 30 s verification interval.
serverless_llm.blocker: The current local scale-to-zero/delete path does not reclaim the GPU allocation; therefore it cannot switch to the 3B model on the 10 GiB GPU without an unsafe external kill.

blockers: the pinned Go build requires unavailable gpgme and btrfs development headers; a CGO-disabled attempt is incompatible with the vendored NVML binding
swapserve_llm.evidence_scope: local environment observation; exact blocker command/log bundle was not retained

kvcached.gate_observation: The official artifact previously passed a single-model OpenAI inference smoke on this RTX 3080.
kvcached.blocker: kvcached is an elastic KV-cache/memory manager and the tested API did not expose the two-model weight lifecycle contract needed for an A/B weight-switch comparison. It is a related mechanism, not a drop-in weight-switch baseline.
kvcached.note: No kvcached latency is inferred or reused; the previous smoke had no retained raw artifact and is therefore provenance-only evidence.
